title: Aggregate resource discovery must disclose server failures
initial_state: fresh ephemeral exec; synthetic MCP server initializes successfully
task: Discover available schema/document resources before a coding task.
constraints: No private files, sessions, or credentials in results
Only resource discovery calls are replayed
expected_invariants: A resource-supporting server's inventory failure must remain visible in the model-facing tool output, rather than becoming an unqualified successful empty/partial inventory.
success_criteria: Error or partial-inventory metadata names the unavailable server and communicates the inventory failure.
preregistration: Invariant written before first fixture execution. Exploratory pilots excluded. Matrix repetitions raised from 3 to 10 before confirmatory matrix. Do not infer model behavior from protocol replay.
